quotedTweet.text:
I made a Hermes skill for task delegation when I use Qwen 27B locally on the DGX Spark and I tell it to create a cron job with a task list to ring each hour and then give it a long task list for coding on multiple projects at the same time. 

The disadvantage is that I do not see anymore on Telegram verbose what it's doing but the advantage is that it speeds things up as it takes advantage of the total throughput of the Spark when concurrency it's high.

It uses up to 6-7 agents at once...I could push that further as the context pool is not filled even 40% somehow even thou it's around 800K tokens total. 

The best way to check that total throughput it's actually better is to look at my dashboard where it calculates the cloud API cost savings projected from the last hour of work. 

With one stream it stays around $ 7-10K API cost save a year and now that it uses 2-7 streams it stays around $ 17.5K and it keeps finishing jobs and that sets me off from pushing that number higher as I don't know for the moment what other jobs to give it. 😂 

Look at the bottom row to see the 1 year projection.

One of the agents is now building a Web UI to see thinking traces and actions verbose for all the subagents. 😁

Qwopus3.8-27B-Flash is a fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B trained to reason more efficiently. so I measured it against its base on my RTX 5090.

the efficiency gain is about 2x:

GPQA-diamond, thinking on, greedy, 198 questions:
- Flash: 70.7%, 4,229 tokens per correct answer, 2.7 hours
- base: 79.3%, 7,740 tokens per correct answer, 5.5 hours
- on the 125 questions both get right, the base thinks 2.08x longer

so half the tokens and half the wall time for the same set, paid for with 8.6 points: the tune has learnt to stop early, and on the hardest questions it sometimes stops before it is done.

two more things from the same run:
- MTP speculative decode: both models sit at 61 tok/s plain and 109 to 145 with the head, acceptance 0.76 vs 0.77 thinking-off.
- 150 of 164 HumanEval answers put exactly one space before every code line, so nested blocks arrive flat and one-shot Python reads 26.8 vs 94.5.

quotedTweet.text:
Good morning, Y'ALL!

Qwopus 3.8 27B Flash is out now! I feel like this one is the largest leap of added value we've ever committed in a fine-tune!

It's very similar to the base model at xhigh, but is significantly more efficient in its CoT, sometimes by a factor of 10 or greater. Not only is it much more concise generally, but it chooses when to use it more, where needed, and when to apply it less.

It runs exceptionally well with thinking uncapped in agentic workflows, unlike the base, especially in Claude Code!

A testament to the model's ACTUAL speed (wall time), it is incredibly usable and feels snappy running on an old V100 at only 37tps average. It is BLAZING fast on a 5090 at around 100tps with MTP! 

Blessed to be here, y'all; we appreciate every one of you greatly! Big thanks to @Alibaba_Qwen and @QwenDevs for making such incredible base models for us to play with!

Please post your wins and your feedback on this one in the comments below; we're looking forward to hearing from you!
